description: This file defines the interface for the LwM2M engine, including initialization, context management, socket operations, resource handling, and firmware update support within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_validate_write_access
methods.description: Validates if writing is permitted on a specific object resource.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_context_close
methods.description: Closes and resets the LwM2M client context, removing all observes and pending messages.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_context_init
methods.description: Initializes a LwM2M client context before socket association.

methods.name: lwm2m_get_message_buf
methods.description: Retrieves the message buffer used by the engine.

methods.name: lwm2m_put_message_buf
methods.description: Returns a message buffer to the engine.

methods.name: lwm2m_perform_composite_observation_op
methods.description: Performs a composite observation operation.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_bootstrap_override
methods.description: Checks if bootstrap override is applicable for a given context and path.

methods.name: bootstrap_delete
methods.description: Deletes an object instance, typically from bootstrap server requests.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_add_service
methods.description: Schedules a periodic service in the work queue.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_update_service_period
methods.description: Updates or removes a scheduled service period.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_call_at
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_call_now
methods.description: Executes a service immediately in the engine context.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_inst_id_to_index
methods.description: Gets index of security object by instance id.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_short_id_to_inst
methods.description: Retrieves security object instance id by short id.

methods.name: lwm2m_security_index_to_inst_id
methods.description: Gets security object instance id by list index.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_state_inst
methods.description: Sets firmware update state for a specific object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_result_inst
methods.description: Sets firmware update result for a specific object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_state
methods.description: Sets firmware update state for default instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_set_update_result
methods.description: Sets firmware update result for default instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_state_inst
methods.description: Gets firmware update state for a specific object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_state
methods.description: Gets firmware update state for default instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_result_inst
methods.description: Gets firmware update result for a specific object instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_firmware_get_update_result
methods.description: Gets firmware update result for default instance.

methods.name: lwm2m_open_socket
methods.description: Opens a socket for a client context.

methods.name: lwm2m_close_socket
methods.description: Closes the socket associated with a client context.

methods.name: lwm2m_socket_suspend
methods.description: Suspends the socket in the work loop.

methods.name: lwm2m_socket_add
methods.description: Adds an existing socket to the work loop.

methods.name: lwm2m_socket_del
methods.description: Removes a socket from the work loop.

methods.name: lwm2m_socket_start
methods.description: Creates and adds a socket for a client context.

methods.name: lwm2m_socket_close
methods.description: Closes the socket for a client context.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_close_socket_connection
methods.description: Closes socket connection when queue mode is active.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_connection_resume
methods.description: Resumes socket connection, requires DTLS support.

methods.name: lwm2m_push_queued_buffers
methods.description: Moves queued messages to pending state.

methods.name: lwm2m_sock_ctx
methods.description: Returns the list of socket contexts.

methods.name: lwm2m_sock_nfds
methods.description: Returns the number of file descriptors for sockets.

methods.name: lwm2m_engine_wake_up
methods.description: Wakes up the engine to process new transmissions or schedule changes.
